name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-intempus
title: Intempus
description: MCP server for Visma Intempus: time registration, approval, balances, cases and planning.

environmentVariables.name: INTEMPUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Intempus API key of that user.

environmentVariables.name: INTEMPUS_DEFAULT_USER
environmentVariables.description: Acting user over stdio, e.g. your own sign-in address.

environmentVariables.name: INTEMPUS_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Role or comma-separated roles: employee, approver, admin.

environmentVariables.name: INTEMPUS_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log.
